newsitem.title: YEMEN: Former north and south Yemen link power grids.
newsitem.headline: Former north and south Yemen link power grids.

text.p: The former north and south Yemen on Tuesday linked their power grids in a $64 million project.
State television showed officials launching the link a day after the impoverished Arab state celebrated on Monday the end of a two-month civil war in 1994.
Officials said the Kuwait-based Arab Fund for Economic and Social Development provided a $54 million loan to finance the project while Yemen paid the rest.
The two Yemen's merged in May 1990 but the former south Yemen led a failed bid in 1994 to secede.
